daily_top5.title: World Rabies Day 2026 - World Health Organization (WHO)
daily_top5.summary: Every year on 28 September, the global community comes together to raise awareness about rabies elimination! This year’s World Rabies Day theme, “Stronger Together,” highlights a simple truth: rabies elimination is only possible when we work together.
